whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Ram Babu Hotel & Restaurant,

I noticed your restaurant has an impressive 3.9★ rating with over 1,300 reviews in Kankarbagh, but lacked a dedicated mobile booking and menu page for local diners.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp food ordering, digital menu, aur table reservation integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/rambabu

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Ram Babu Hotel & Restaurant team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with a digital food menu, table booking, and direct WhatsApp ordering for your customers in Kankarbagh. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes, pricing, aur actual photos integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
